name: msdoc-form
description: Table-first MS-DOC (.doc) parser and preview — Chinese administrative forms first

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @msdoc-form/core build && pnpm --filter @msdoc-form/vue build && pnpm --filter @msdoc-form/react build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @msdoc-form/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @msdoc-form/vue typecheck && pnpm --filter @msdoc-form/react typecheck
